book_title: Easy Access Rules for Standardised European Rules of the Air (SERA)

elements.text: GNSS. If any portion of the flight is planned to be conducted under IFR, it
refers to GNSS receivers that comply with the requirements of Annex 10,
VHF with 8.33 kHz channel spacing capability
